en: Hi hi! I'm Acerola, and you're the island challenger Sophocles told me about! He said you were scary. You don't look scary at all.
I've got a trial for you in the old Thrifty Megamart, just there. Don't mind the dust. Or the ghosts.
I'll open the door. Go on in whenever you like. My Mimikyu is waiting in the dark, and he's very shy.
The Megamart's door is open. Mind the dark, and mind the ghosts. They like you already.
This ridge is no road for the weak-kneed. Come back when you've been to the observatory and I'll lend you a Mudsdale.
You're the trial-goer I've heard about! Take my Mudsdale. She can trot over rubble that would break your ankles.
{player} registered Mudsdale in the Ride Pager! Mudsdale can gallop over rough ground.
Mudsdale is a good horse. Strong, steady and not the least bit clever.
